maya: quick async: model onboard: llama-3-mini-q (quantized) — ran eval batch on 5k dev examples overnight. Observed ~6% F1 drop vs v1 on the NER subset. collected logs in /mnt/evals/3118/ner-drop.csv. main suspect: tokenization difference and prompt truncation on longer contexts.
sri: thanks. did you check kv cache warmup or prefix handling?
maya: yes — prefix caching looks okay. sample diff shows tokenizer emits extra space before punctuation for Spanish examples. also one prompt in promptset-legal has trailing triple hyphen that previously got removed. attached a minimal repro below.
maya: ```bash
python3 eval.py --model /models/llama3-mini-q --promptset promptset-legal.jsonl --start 1234 --end 1244 --output /tmp/repro.json
```
jen: can you paste one of the failing examples?
maya: pasted example: "¿Dónde está el contrato -- firmado?" -> model tokenizes as ["¿","Dónde","está","el","contrato","--","firmado","?"] vs baseline removed the `--`. small but changes alignment.
tom: if it's tokenizer, we can swap to the baseline tokenizer code path. patch is trivial, but need a short dedicated slot to smoke test across 10k tokens. infra-bot can we grab a 20m slot on dedicated-1?
infra-bot: @tom reserving dedicated-1 for 20m at 10:30 PST. Claim id: CLM-3118. :white_check_mark:
sri: if patch is trivial, can we add a pre-commit test that normalizes hyphen sequences? avoids future regressions.
maya: yes I'll add a small unit test and a gating eval (50 examples) that runs in CI. plan today: push tokenizer fix, add unit test, rerun small eval, then escalate full 5k run if passes.
jen: LGTM. also quick CR ping: maya — created a tiny PR? drop link.
maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7823 — title "tokenizer: normalize hyphen sequences for spanish prompts". PTAL @jen @sri
eval-bot: nightly-eval finished 3118034500 — all other models stable. flag created for llama-3-mini-q NER gap +6.2%. Ticket: INF-1429
jen: ok filing a small alert for product so they know latency unaffected. maya — need anything from me?
maya: not right now, thanks. will update thread when gating eval passes. :sunglasses:
